item.description:
Release v5.24.1

Changes since v5.24.0

  • feat(PluginLLMManager): add hint text to LLM provider onboarding page 提示用户可随时在「设置 > 云端供应商」中进行配置
  • feat(ProviderProject): add ProjectChangeReason enum to project change API
  • feat(ProviderProject): propagate ProjectChangeReason through events
  • fix(message-list-brief): stabilize conversation state bar layout with fixed height
  • fix(message-list): keep streaming output pinned to bottom
  • fix(Packages): add iOS 17 platform declaration to all Swift packages
  • fix(PluginDeveloperMode): hide DEV button in release builds
  • fix(PluginDeveloperMode): resolve ToolbarItem type conflict with SwiftUI
  • fix(PluginProjectFileTree): update pattern match for currentProjectChanged event
  • fix(projects): inject conversation-bound project path
  • fix(theme): refresh system appearance changes
  • refactor: remove BookletMaker standalone app, keep plugin only
  • refactor(message-list-brief): extract conversation state into dedicated ViewModel and View
  • refactor(message-list-brief): organize external observers
  • refactor(message-list-brief): remove dead code and unused helpers
  • refactor(message-list-brief): remove unused capabilities and lift developer mode observation
  • refactor(message-list-brief): remove unused message list code
  • refactor(message-list-brief): replace custom observer pattern with ObservableObject in AgentTurnViewModel
  • refactor(message-list-brief): simplify view model naming
  • refactor(message-list-brief): split capabilities by concern
